stem: Which situation was one result of Jim Crow transportation laws?

options.label: A
options.text: African Americans had to pay twice the amount for bus fare as white people traveling the same route.

options.label: B
options.text: African Americans had to stay in designated areas on buses even if seats in the white section were vacant.

options.label: C
options.text: African Americans had to board buses before white people were allowed to enter.

options.label: D
options.text: African Americans had to create bus routes separate from those for white people.
